status: Implemented; focused, default and Worker validation passed
change: Owned top-k exposes a read-only competitiveness check against its worst retained candidate. Borrowed row queries perform this check before detachment; authoritative offer still rechecks the owned candidate. Later ties cannot displace earlier winners. Comparator failure closes the selector.

cases: precheck requires no allocation under full sibling pressure
oversized later ties and worse payloads do not require copies
validation.followup: After the full run, all nine owned-top-k tests passed including the new precheck comparator-failure cleanup case.

benchmarks.conditions: 4096 ascending borrowed rows, k=8, two warmups and three timed rounds; 64-byte and 64-KiB binary payloads. Deterministic winner checks and zero final usage every round. Source hashes recorded; baseline query hash verified against prior commit.
benchmarks.wideResult: Median time 103.82ms to 2.03ms; cumulative detached binary allocation charges 268959744 to 525312 bytes; peak explicit reservations 598094 to 532464 bytes. These are local runs and reservation units, not remote latency or total VM heap.

remaining: Input keys must remain stable between synchronous precheck and offer. Broader fallback output, serialization and unlimited-sort ownership remain open.
